action.objective: Verify Nf6+ as a forcing alternative, comparing to Qa1 before committing.
action.rationale: Broad search flagged e4f6 with an upper bound at 99997 (mate-range) and PV Nf6+ Kh8 Rxh7. Qa1 is already verified exact 99997 at depth 3 with PV Qa1 cxb4 Qa8. Both threaten immediate promotion-like mate. Compare Nf6+ since check may be more forcing; if weaker, commit Qa1.
